name: jdi-cli
description: JDI (Just Do It) — lean workflow toolkit for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, OpenCode, and JetBrains Junie. 17 slash commands (/jdi-issue autonomous intake + /jdi-next auto-router + 7 loop + ralph + adopt + meta + roadmap mutation + DoD confirm), 7 core agents (incl. jdi-solo for delegated coding-agent sessions) + N per-project specialists with file-glob routing. Conflict-free .jdi state layout (one file = one writer — server-side PR merges ignore merge=union; migrate-layout for existing projects). Definition of Done as reviewer Gate 8. Mechanical artifact gates (validate-phase + pre-commit + CI workflow) for autonomous agents. Optional Playwright MCP + Caveman plugin install.
author: JDI contributors

scripts.test:local: npm pack && node -e "console.log('Package generated. Test with: npx ./jdi-cli-' + require('./package.json').version + '.tgz install <runtime>')"
